design_basis: Plastic Ox story v0.6.1 + Gen I-III route inventory

towns.name: Pallet Town
towns.notes: Start. North land; south water continuity route.

towns.name: Cherrygrove City
towns.notes: Two native land seams plus natural west coast.

towns.name: Goldenrod City
towns.notes: North/south overworld; Magnet Train is a late transit edge.

towns.name: Ecruteak City
towns.notes: Three useful land ports; north is reserved for Bell Tower context.

towns.name: Cinnabar Island
towns.notes: Island. Use only proven north/east water seams.

towns.name: Mossdeep City
towns.notes: Three proven water seams; no invented east exit.

towns.name: Saffron City
towns.notes: Use all four gatehouse ports when possible; late-game gating is encouraged.

towns.name: Blackthorn City
towns.notes: North represents Ice Path arrival; south represents Route 45 descent.

towns.name: Oldale Town
towns.notes: Optional Hoenn starter-area town. South connects to Route 101; west to Route 102; north to Route 103.

towns.name: Pacifidlog Town
towns.notes: Optional Hoenn water town on the southern ocean. West connects to Route 131; east to Route 132.

routes.name: Route 4
routes.notes: split by Mt. Moon in source

routes.name: Route 6
routes.theme: urban meadow; water and gate approach

routes.name: Route 8
routes.theme: fenced grass; urban gate; Underground Path

routes.name: Route 20
routes.notes: Whirl Islands replace Seafoam in current concept

routes.name: Route 32
routes.theme: long coastal road; fishing; ruins/cave approaches

routes.name: Route 38
routes.theme: farm meadow and gentle rolling road

routes.name: Route 102
routes.theme: farm route; pond and early grass

routes.name: Route 119
routes.theme: rain; tall grass; river; Weather Institute

required_dungeons.name: Mt. Moon
required_dungeons.notes: Rocket I; through-dungeon between mountain routes.

required_dungeons.name: National Park
required_dungeons.notes: Mandatory breathing-space traversal between Goldenrod and Ecruteak.

required_dungeons.name: Burned Tower
required_dungeons.notes: Local Ecruteak story dungeon; usually attached to Ecruteak rather than used as a regional through-edge.

required_dungeons.name: Weather Institute
required_dungeons.notes: Located on Route 119; local facility attachment is usually preferable.

required_dungeons.name: Pokémon Mansion
required_dungeons.notes: Unlocked after Blaine; Entei encounter inside.

required_dungeons.name: Whirl Islands
required_dungeons.notes: Treat as the dungeon module embedded in the Route 41 water corridor.

required_dungeons.name: Silph Co.
required_dungeons.notes: Rocket III / Giovanni / world-crisis climax; local Saffron attachment.

required_dungeons.name: Sea Cottage
required_dungeons.notes: Optional story branch / Eevee; should not become a mandatory regional dead end.
